nodes.title: SG-8.4 · Rewrite repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md still says the repo holds only README.md with 'hello Worldseed' and has 13 UNKNOWN placeholders. The code holds game/src (Phaser core), game/frontend/src (React client), game/docs/GDD.md and backend (Go). Desired behavior: context.md names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest and Go, lists the real module paths and has no stale text. Expected result: the contextStack and context module path unit tests pass. Why: agents rely on context.md to understand the repository.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the rewritten context.md, when missingTerms runs against STACK_TERMS, then it returns an empty array.
- Given the rewritten context.md, when it is searched, then it contains no UNKNOWN and no staleTextHits.
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths is mapped through existsSync, then missingPaths is empty and game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ are listed.


## Scope
- In scope: context.md stack section
- In scope: context.md module table and entry points
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code
- Out of scope: new features
- Out of scope: other SG-8 steps
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0
- Preserve: gameplay behaviour
- Preserve: all existing tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test deleted or skipped
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope
- Only paths that exist may be referenced


## Definition of done
- contextStack.test.ts and contextDoc.test.ts pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md Stack names the real stack and drops README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: docsCheck.ts exports STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT. Desired behavior: the Purpose and Stack sections of context.md name every STACK_TERMS entry plus Go for backend, and contain none of STALE_TEXT and no UNKNOWN. Expected result: contextStack.test.ts passes. Why: the current text describes a README-only repo.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then the result is [].
- Given context.md, when it is matched against /\bGo\b/, then it matches.
- Given context.md, when staleTextHits runs and /UNKNOWN/ is tested, then there are no hits and no match.


## Scope
- In scope: Purpose and Stack sections of context.md
- Out of scope: backend code changes
- Preserve: STACK_TERMS contract


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No test is deleted or skipped
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- Stack and stale-text tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists the real game, docs and backend paths
nodes.body:
Context: contextModulePaths extracts backticked game/ and backend/ paths from table rows. Desired behavior: the module table lists game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ and every path exists on disk. Expected result: contextDoc.test.ts passes. Why: the old table lists only README.md and .gitignore.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when contextModulePaths runs, then it contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/.
- Given those paths, when missingPaths runs with existsSync from the repo root, then it returns [].
- Given context.md, when searched, then it has no 'No `src/`' or 'README.md only' text.


## Scope
- In scope: Modules and entry points tables of context.md
- Out of scope: moving or creating source files
- Preserve: contextModulePaths contract


## Technical constraints
- Reference only paths that exist
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- backend/ is Go and out of scope


## Definition of done
- Module path tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
